items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I knew him. All the harm he did was to himself, because he was drunk all the time.

ctx.x: I knew him. All the harm he did was to himself, because he was drunk all the time. And how Lil could tolerate him, I don't know. Because she was such a good girl. Lil was a good girl.
But now Lovie Austin used to dress in leopard skin?
